_doc: Description exacte de chaque élément du produit, ajoutée aux prompts quand sa référence est jointe : Gemini ne doit rien réinventer.
produit-devidoir: A spool of black thread with RED plastic end caps on both ends, sitting on an open-frame unwinder made of light birch plywood: two flat side uprights with rounded tops connected by horizontal rails, standing on small legs, a wooden axle through the spool between the uprights, visible laser-cut plywood edges. Never simplify it into a cradle or another holder; never change the red caps.
kit-bobine: A spool of black thread with RED plastic end caps on a light birch plywood open-frame unwinder (two side uprights, horizontal rails, small legs, wooden axle).
kit-boite-support: A flat square kraft cardboard box (about 55 x 55 cm, a few cm thick) with a thin black-line string art pattern and the script word 'Deekra' printed on the lid; the box folds open into an inclined stand that holds the board.
kit-assemblage: A WHITE SQUARE board (50 x 50 cm) with brass nails forming a perfect circle near the edges, held at an angle by the kraft box stand; a smartphone on a small light-wood stand beside it.
kit-notice: A small printed instruction booklet in off-white paper with black line illustrations.
support-chevalet: A light birch plywood easel stand: two tall triangular A-shaped legs with a small ledge at the bottom, clean laser-cut edges.
etape-voix-telephone: A smartphone on a small light birch phone stand next to a WHITE board with brass nails; the phone shows a white app screen with a circular progress indicator.
etape-ouvrir-boite: A large flat kraft cardboard box with a thin black-line string art pattern on the lid, containing a WHITE square board with brass nails.
planche: The board is always a WHITE SQUARE board (50 x 50 cm) with brass nails forming a perfect circle; never a raw wooden or round board.
